div.div: The goal of the Filtering phase is simple: Find all nodes that are physically and logically capable of hosting the Pod.

div.div: The scheduler runs a series of checks (Filter plugins, formerly Predicates) against every node. If a node fails even one check, it is tossed out.

div.div: This is the simplest form of placement control. If your Pod YAML has a nodeSelector (e.g., disktype: ssd), the scheduler will immediately discard any node that doesn't have that exact label.

div.div: If your pod wants to use a specific hostPort (like port 80 directly on the EC2 instance), and another pod on that node is already using it, the node is disqualified. You can't have two "renters" using the same "mailbox."
